---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? Is your feature request related to a frustration?

## Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like. How should this feature work?

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Case
Describe a specific use case where this feature would be helpful.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.

## Checklist
- [ ] I have searched for existing feature requests
- [ ] I have checked the roadmap for planned features
- [ ] This feature aligns with the project's goals
